title: YOLO11m fine-tuned on SKU dataset hallucinating and missing DuoPack detections
body_excerpt: I am working on a retail shelf product detection system using YOLO11m fine-tuned on a 110k SKU dataset with a single class `product`. The model performs well overall but I have two problems after adding synthetic images of a specific product called DuoPack. Background : DuoPack is a product that consists of two single packs joined together. The model was not detecting it reliably, so I generated ~500 synthetic images of it using augmentation on shelf backgrounds and retrained the model. Problems: 1.
